metadata.title: TinyFloor - A Virtual Office You Can Walk Around
metadata.description: TinyFloor is a free virtual office in your browser. Walk around a pixel-art floor with your team and start a video call just by standing next to someone.
metadata.ogAlt: A TinyFloor room: a 16-bit office floor with desks and teammates
metadata.keywords: virtual office, remote work, spatial chat, online collaboration, virtual workspace, proximity chat, proximity video chat, virtual coworking space, browser video calls
metadata.joinRoomDescription: You're invited to {office} on TinyFloor, a virtual office you walk around in. Open the link, pick a character and walk in.
metadata.authDescription: Sign in to TinyFloor to keep your name, your character and a list of your rooms.
metadata.lobbyDescription: Try TinyFloor's demo office in your browser. Pick a character, walk around and try a proximity call before you make an office for your team.
metadata.inviteDescription: Join {office} on TinyFloor, a virtual office you walk around in.
